issues.desc: Background/checklist scope-policy conflict: Conversational Texture says critical or high defects stay in this Story without an applicability condition, while corrected CHK-003 requires applicability and gate impact to be assessed separately and permits a verified non-applicable critical/high defect to leave only with strong nonblocking proof plus a traceable owner/route. Because the background is a controlling INIT truth source, this unconditional wording can re-authorize unrelated scope expansion. Align the background with CHK-003 before INIT_CHECK. CHK-004 itself is appropriately bounded to BUG-001 because that medium defect directly blocks B-212f verification evidence and lifecycle acceptance.
